title: Побег в холодильник и поездка с полицией  (Hiding in the Fridge and Riding with the Police)

segments.t: While Lyova wonders where Nagiyev disappeared to, Senya and Fedya haul their bound captive inside the restaurant to stash him in the walk-in cooler. Across town, Chef Barinov convinces the skeptical police officers to drive him directly to Claude Monet to prove who he is.
Он был здесь недавно, но ушёл куда-то.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Do you happen to know?' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'know' without extra filler words. Dmitry answers right away.
'Where is Dmitry Vladimirovich?' The meaning hinges on 'where' working together with 'Vladimirovich' in spoken Russian.
Он был здесь недавно, но ушёл куда-то.
'He was here recently, but he went off somewhere.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'he' and finishing on 'somewhere'.
'We need to take him...' Dmitry brings out the contrast between 'him' and 'at' in a few short words. Lyova answers right away.
'We need to take him to the restaurant.' The meaning hinges on 'him' working together with 'restaurant' in spoken Russian.
'And we will sort it out there.' Dmitry brings out the contrast between 'and' and 'there' in a few short words.
'I am a celebrity, after all.' Lyova anchors the line on 'I', while 'a star' completes the thought. Dmitry answers right away.
'Or maybe?' In Russian, the idea of 'and' flows naturally into 'maybe' without extra filler words.
'Let me make the call myself.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'let's' before landing on 'will call'.
'Come on, let us go.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'let's' and finishing on 'let's go'. Lyova answers right away.
'Hey, hey.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'hey' and finishing on 'hey'.
'Let us go. Hey.' Dmitry anchors the line on 'let's go', while 'hey' completes the thought.
'Hey, hold it right there!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'to stand for a while'. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Он был здесь недавно, но ушёл куда-то.

That wraps up this scene as senya and Fedya haul the bound captive into the restaurant walk-in fridge, while Chef Barinov persuades the police officers to drive him to Claude Monet. See you next time!
